notes.title: Promotion boundary
items: Box TP/SL + D+5 keeps native Box exits and closes the remainder from D+5 on an event-free session.
Box Breakout Fill enters only when the next session touches the projected same-side boundary and preserves native exits.
OOS starts on 2026-01-01 and rolls through the latest usable cached ACWI session; stale ACWI defers OOS metrics without hiding current Momentum signals.
Relative Equilibrium is a daily LONG-alpha plus factor-hedge strategy; it does not use intraday signals.
Manual Momentum scans show EMA alignment transitions; scheduled daily messages remain unchanged.
D+5 Close remains selectable in Beta; Strategy Default remains the default.
The selected exit policy applies symmetrically to LONG and SHORT portfolio trades.
All candidates, markets, and states are deliberately synthetic.
The view checks message hierarchy and labels, not strategy performance.
